title: Heinrich Boll Foundation Study Scholarship (Master's and PhD in Germany)
description: A scholarship from the Heinrich Boll Foundation (Germany's Green-aligned political foundation) supporting international graduate and doctoral students pursuing a Master's degree, Diplom/State Exam main phase, or PhD at a German higher education institution, in any academic discipline. Open to German, EU, and non-EU applicants (including refugees based in Germany); non-EU applicants must already be admitted to, or in the final stages of applying to, a German degree program. Beyond academic merit, the foundation looks for applicants who are politically and socially engaged and share its core values of ecology/sustainability, democracy and human rights, and self-determination and justice. Master's/Diplom students receive up to EUR 855/month plus a EUR 300/month book allowance; PhD students receive EUR 1,400/month plus a EUR 100/month mobility allowance; both tracks include health insurance and possible family/childcare allowances. Good to very good German (at least B2/DSH1) is required regardless of the language of instruction. The foundation runs two application rounds every year, with deadlines of March 1 and September 1; the application portal opens about six weeks before each deadline. This entry covers the September 1, 2026 round.
visaNote: This is a study scholarship, not employment; non-EU recipients need a German student visa/residence permit, arranged once university admission is confirmed.
